text:
sophie-customer: Hi team — we have an enterprise security questionnaire (bespoke) due next Wed. While pulling logs we saw a burst of 401 auth failures around 2026-03-10T15:04:30Z and a corresponding billing token spike. We need: 1) root cause and repro steps for the 401s, 2) audit log extract for 15:00–15:10 UTC, 3) KMS/HSM rotation attestation or proof of key custody for the key used, and 4) confirmation of log retention windows. This is for their compliance pack, requester is our security reviewer. Can you help?

leo-cs: Thanks Sophie — pinging eng & security. Can you share any sample request IDs, customer_app_id, and the invoice id you saw the spike on? Also confirm whether those 401s show up in our gateway or in the customer's client side.

sophie-customer: Request IDs: req_8f3a2c and req_8f3a9b. customer_app_id: acme-payments-prod. Invoice id: INV-2026-03-0098 (billing dashboard snapshot attached in original email). Failures show in our gateway logs (downstream 401 from auth service).

ajay-eng: Looking. Quick note: 401s often mean expired/rotated API key or malformed Authorization header. Can you paste the raw header or a curl that reproduces it? If you prefer redacted, include `x-request-id` and timestamp.

sophie-customer: Raw header redacted but header had `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>` — we rotated keys yesterday morning but the client says they didn't update keys on their side until later. Might be mismatch window.

ajay-eng: Ok that timeline helps. Running a grep for those req ids. Found this in proxy logs (redacted):
```n
2026-03-10T15:04:31Z host=gw-12 req_id=req_8f3a2c status=401 upstream=auth service_error=invalid_token token_expired=true key_id=key-749
2026-03-10T15:05:02Z host=gw-12 req_id=req_8f3a9b status=401 upstream=auth service_error=invalid_token token_expired=true key_id=key-749
```

ajay-eng: Preliminary: looks like those 401s are genuine token expiry/rotation mismatches for key_id key-749. Repro steps: 1) use an old API key for a request during rotation window; 2) expect 401 with `invalid_token` and token_expired=true. Example curl that fails if key expired:
```n
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY" 
 -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

maria-sec: FYI I'm pulling the KMS rotation logs and HSM attestation for key-749. We need to confirm whether key-749 was part of an automated rotation job or manual. Also need permission to share redacted rotation attestations with the customer. Are we allowed to include a KMS audit bundle in their SIG package?

leo-cs: Sophie, do we have a signed NDA for this customer? If not, we can still provide redacted logs and an attestation statement but not full key material.

sophie-customer: NDA is in place (signed 2025-11-02). You can include redacted logs and the attestation PDF. They specifically asked for rotation timestamps and whether HSM-backed keystore was used.

maria-sec: Got it. I pulled rotation events from KMS: key-749 rotation initiated 2026-03-10T02:00:00Z, completed 2026-03-10T02:00:07Z. But the token used by the client appears to have been minted before rotation and expired during their replay window. I'm preparing an attestation PDF that confirms HSM usage and rotation metadata (CA/serial redacted). Will stub a short statement: "Key custody: HSM-backed; rotation event logged at [ts]; no plaintext key export."

taylor-billing: I looked at the billing spike. It aligns with a retry storm from that client between 15:00–15:12 UTC. The meter shows an increase of ~12k tokens compared to baseline. Can Sophie share the trace ids for those requests? That will help map tokens to invoice.

sophie-customer: Adding trace ids: trc-77a4, trc-77a5, trc-77b0. Attaching customer timeline: they reported auth failures and retried 4x each attempt.

ajay-eng: That matches: retries increased token consumption and caused the billing blip. We should include safe guidance for customers: backoff + check for 401 vs 5xx. For immediate mitigation, we can offer a one-time adjustment if the retry behavior was caused by our rotation window and our docs didn't warn them. Sophie — want me to draft the billing appeal text?

leo-cs: Also, to close the compliance ask: we'll assemble a package with 1) redacted gateway logs for 15:00–15:12 UTC, 2) KMS rotation attestation PDF, 3) statement of data retention (logs retained 90 days by default, can extend with enterprise plan), 4) a short repro and mitigation note (what ajay wrote). ETA: 48 hours to produce pack. Is that acceptable to the customer?

sophie-customer: 48 hours is fine. Please put the redaction rules in the pack — remove any PII and full key material. The auditor also wants a hash or chain-of-custody for the attestation PDF.

maria-sec: We'll include an SHA256 digest of the attestation and timestamped S3 object write logs (redacted). Also include a reference to our HSM vendor attestation (redacted serials).

incident-bot: Created ticket RDW-98765 for "Customer SIG evidence request — acme-payments-prod" (priority P2). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RDW-98765

taylor-billing: For billing adj, Sophie please confirm whether customer accepts a credit or prefers invoice reissue. If they prefer credit, we'll propose credit proportional to excess tokens after retries are accounted for.

sophie-customer: Customer prefers a credit. Please draft a one-time credit for the excess tokens attributed to the retry storm and I'll route approval.

leo-cs: Action items: @ajay-eng — assemble redacted logs + repro text. @maria-sec — attestation PDF + SHA256 + rotation metadata. @taylor-billing — calculate excess tokens and draft credit text. @sophie-customer — confirm final acceptance and we'll attach pack to RDW-98765.

ajay-eng: Will upload logs to a pre-signed S3 link (redacted in thread) and attach to ticket.

maria-sec: Uploading attestation now, will include hash in ticket comment.

sophie-customer: Thanks all — please cc me on the ticket comments. This covers compliance and the customer's finance ask.

leo-cs: Thanks team. We'll close the loop in RDW-98765. :white_check_mark:
